data.one_liner: Compare two images for visual differences using multiple algorithms
data.what_it_does: image_compare lets you compare two image sources (URL, file, bytes, or Image object) and returns a percentage difference. It supports several algorithms such as pixel matching, Euclidean color distance, histogram methods, and perceptual hashing. The package handles resizing, optional alpha channel handling, and works on all major platforms.
use_when: You need to detect visual differences between images in tests or CI pipelines
You want to compare images for similarity or exactness in a Dart/Flutter app
You need a pure Dart solution without native dependencies
avoid_when: You only need a simple equality check of image bytes
You are building a UI component that displays image differences
strengths: Multiple comparison algorithms with configurable options
Pure Dart implementation, no native code required
Supports all major platforms via universal_io
weaknesses: No built‑in UI for visualizing differences
Performance may be slower for large images
Limited to image comparison, no other image processing features
data.setup_notes: Add dependency to pubspec and import 'package:image_compare/image_compare.dart'; no special permissions needed
